name: Appearance Management
description: Clothing and equipment choices directly affect how personnel and security staff perceive an operator. Tactical clothing, multi-pocket vests, military-style gear, and anything that reads as 'security professional' draws attention in civilian environments. The target environment's dress code — identified during recon — should dictate attire. Hi-vis is paradoxically one of the most effective cover appearances in many environments because it signals 'authorized worker' without requiring further explanation.

blue.det: Inconsistencies in attire relative to stated role; uniform not matching known vendor or contractor style; security staff challenge.
blue.cm: Approved vendor uniform reference guide for security staff; challenge culture; all visitors required to present verifiable ID regardless of attire.
